notes: Fast-hire options in Tacoma/Pierce County for people who need income this week. They appear beside training routes as help, never as a career route.
Rule applied: included only where the organization's own website states day pay, walk-in dispatch, or second-chance hiring. Aggregator 'felony-friendly' lists were not accepted as evidence.
No staffing agency here is described as a second-chance employer: neither LaborWorks nor PeopleReady states that on its own site today. See the 'excluded' section at the end for what was checked.
PeopleReady offers next-day pay on many jobs (not same-day). It is drafted for your decision; delete it before approving if next-day doesn't meet the bar.
Every quote is re-checked against its live page on each sync. Set status to 'reviewed' and fill reviewed_by / reviewed_on to load these records.

programs.name: LaborWorks (Tacoma)
programs.summary: A day-labor and temporary staffing agency with a Tacoma office. Apply in person at the branch (about 30-45 minutes for new candidates) or online, and get paid at the end of each workday on a paycard when you return to the office; the office is closed Sundays.
quotes: LaborWorks pays workers at the end of each workday when they return to the office.
The exception is Sunday when the office is closed.
To find work through LaborWorks, visit us in person at a location near you in Washington, Oregon, Nevada, and Colorado.
As a new candidate, please expect the process to take 30-45 minutes.

quotes.text: Work today and get paid today!
LaborWorks in Tacoma, WA links you with skilled laborers

programs.name: PeopleReady (JobStack app)
programs.summary: A staffing agency for general labor, construction, warehouse, and hospitality shifts. Sign up once through its JobStack app with no resume needed; many jobs are eligible for next-day pay.
quotes: Sign up once to access local PeopleReady jobs — no resume needed!
With many roles offering next-day pay, you can start fast and get paid fast.

quotes.text: Plus, many jobs are eligible for next-day pay!

excluded.revisit_when: LaborWorks publishes a second-chance or fair-chance hiring statement on its own site.

excluded.requested: PeopleReady / TrueBlue as a second-chance employer
excluded.decision: Next-day pay included; second-chance hiring not claimed
excluded.why: The only fair-chance wording is standard legal language inside individual job postings, which expire constantly, and a 2022 TrueBlue corporate report. Neither is a current, stable statement on the company's own site.
excluded.revisit_when: PeopleReady or TrueBlue publishes a current second-chance hiring page.

excluded.why: Their 'fair-chance' or 'daily pay' descriptions came only from third-party job-board lists. Trades Labor's Tacoma page returned no readable statement, and Express and Adecco don't advertise day pay.
excluded.revisit_when: Each company's own site states day pay, walk-in dispatch, or second-chance hiring.
